# Project Governance 4.7.0

## Multilingual source context

The maintained local source index now uses pinned Tree-sitter WebAssembly parsers for Rust, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Objective-C and Java. Declaration names and source ranges improve context selection and excerpts while existing captured-source identities, source-sharing permissions and caching remain authoritative. Parsing runs locally without model calls.

Kotlin Multiplatform context preserves authored expect/actual modifiers and source-set path hints. Kotlin Gradle scripts expose authored blocks. Build-file discovery includes Gradle catalogs and wrappers, Cargo, SwiftPM/Xcode, CocoaPods, Dart, Maven, CMake, Make, Node inputs, text lockfiles and native interop definitions. These clues do not resolve build graphs or platform bindings.

Unsupported grammar cases remain explicitly partial and retain labelled search clues. Objective-C++ remains partial. No compiler-level resolution, complete language-version coverage or measured token/time saving is claimed.

## Installation and qualification

This stable release includes the bundled runtime and matching Cowork plugin ZIP. It retains the fixes in 4.6.2. Use the normal deliberate installation process at an owning idle seam; existing installations keep their current pins until updated.

Qualification uses the normal local proof and manual publication path. Source tests, exact installed-package and greenfield journeys, pinned dependency checks and independent Fable 5.2 high-effort review cover this change. Real-repository benefit measurement and additional operating-system qualification remain open. GitHub CI is not used for this 4.x publication.
